overview_description.description:
Bridging the insurance and carbon markets, Kita offers a bespoke portfolio of carbon insurance products that act as a stamp of confidence and safeguard against loss. Carbon insurance helps to de-risk engagement in the carbon markets.

We protect clients against loss of carbon credits due to risks such as natural catastrophes; fraud and negligence; insolvency and abandonment; political risks; and changing carbon standards. Insurance claims can be paid in cash or in replacement carbon credits, providing flexibility for clients' individual risk appetites and carbon strategies.

With reduced risk in the carbon transaction, high quality carbon solutions are able to access greater flows of consistent capital to scale their impact faster, while buyers and investors gain confidence that they are protected against unexpected loss.

We cover the future so that you can act now.

about_short_description.short_description: Kita is an insurance company that offers carbon insurance products and services that cover risks impacting carbon market stakeholders.

product.name: Non-Delivery Insurance
product.description: Insurance protecting buyers and investors against under-delivery of forward purchased carbon credits.

product.name: Counterparty Insurance
product.description: Insurance covering risks of counterparty abandonment or insolvency affecting carbon credit delivery.

product.name: Buffer Depletion Insurance
product.description: Insurance protecting carbon standard buffer pools against depletion from reversal or non-permanence risks.

product.name: Political Risk Insurance
product.description: Insurance covering political, host country, and Article 6 related risks impacting carbon projects and investments.

product.name: Buffer as a Service (BaaS)
product.description: Risk management service for Carbon Standards’ buffer pools to reduce risk and improve operational efficiency.

product.name: Risk Assessment
product.description: Bespoke technical and political risk assessments for carbon projects to support due diligence and risk mitigation.
